第(1/3)页

江灵呆住，她没想到王岩会这么说，王岩狠狠瞪她一眼。

她脸色一僵，不敢再说。

“这样么？”

看到王岩态度，陈若彤眼中意外更浓，点头，“好，既是闹着玩，那就算了，你们可以走了。”

叶凡松开王岩，王岩怨毒的看叶凡一眼，转身就走。

陈若彤突地道，“王少，我得提醒你，以后少和叶凡闹着玩。”

“叶凡现在是我盛宝楼鉴定师，是我们公司的重要资产，我们得保护。”

“你懂我意思么？”

王岩身体一僵，拳头瞬间握紧。

但之后，他就露出比哭还难看的笑容，“好…陈总放心，我明白。”

“嗯，那请吧。”

陈若彤一抬手，王岩对那中年人道，“张师父，咱们走！”

“…是。”

中年人勉力起身，江灵赶忙扶住他们，踉跄离开。

看到这一幕，四周人眼中划过一道意外。

没人是傻子，谁都知道，这绝不是闹着玩。

但叶凡偏能让王岩这么说，还让陈若彤这么支持，自然他们清楚，叶凡，绝对来头不小。

察觉众人目光，叶凡没理会，看向陈若彤。

他知道，现在他得向陈若彤证明自己价值。

不然第一天上班就出这事，肯定没好果子吃。

“陈总，通过我的观察，我已经找到几块高价值原石，您要不要看看？”

“哦？这么快么？”

陈若彤眼中划过精光，“好，那你带我看看吧。”

“是。”

叶凡点头，对陈若彤介绍起来，很快，他就把发现的高价值原石说了一遍。

听完这些，陈若彤眼中划过震惊，她没想到叶凡发现这么多高价值原石。

“好，刚才你看到的，我都会买下，然后我会找师父切开。”

“如果你说的都是真的，没说的，待遇方面，我不会亏待你。”

陈若彤道。

“好。”

Page (1/3)

Jiang Ling was stunned. She didn't expect Wang Yan to say that. Wang Yan glared at her fiercely.

Her face froze and she didn't dare to say anything more.

"Is that so?"

Seeing Wang Yan's attitude, Chen Ruotong's eyes became more surprised and she nodded, "Okay, since it was just a joke, forget it, you can go."

Ye Fan let go of Wang Yan. Wang Yan looked at Ye Fan bitterly, turned around and left.

Chen Ruotong suddenly said, "Young Master Wang, I have to remind you not to play around with Mark from now on."

"Ye Fan is now the appraiser of our Shengbao Building. He is an important asset of our company and we must protect it."

"Do you understand what I mean?"

Wang Yan's body froze and his fists clenched instantly.

But then, he showed a smile that was uglier than crying, "Okay... Don't worry, Mr. Chen, I understand."

"Well, please."

Chen Ruotong raised his hand and Wang Yan said to the middle-aged man, "Master Zhang, let's go!"

"…Yes."

The middle-aged man managed to get up, and Jiang Ling hurriedly supported them and staggered away.

Seeing this scene, surprise flashed in the eyes of the people around.

No one is a fool and everyone knows that this is no joke.

But Ye Fan was able to let Wang Yan say this and let Chen Ruotong support him so much. Naturally, they knew that Ye Fan definitely had a lot of background.

Sensing everyone's gaze, Ye Fan ignored it and looked at Chen Ruotong.

He knew that now he had to prove his worth to Chen Ruotong.

Otherwise, if this happens on the first day of work, there will definitely be no good consequences.

"Mr. Chen, through my observation, I have found several high-value rough stones. Do you want to take a look?"

"Oh? So fast?"

Chen Ruotong's eyes flashed with light, "Okay, then show me."

"Yes."

Ye Fan nodded and introduced Chen Ruotong. Soon, he told about the high-value rough stone he had discovered.

After hearing this, Chen Ruotong's eyes flashed with shock. She didn't expect Ye Fan to find so many high-value rough stones.

"Okay, I will buy what you saw just now, and then I will ask the master to cut it open."

"If what you said is true, and what you didn't say, I won't treat you badly in terms of treatment."

Chen Ruotong said.

"Okay."
